name: FIND MY PAGES
desc:
FIND MY PAGES

a multiplayer slenderman game where the objective is to collect all 8 pages. game is best enjoyed when you're playing with friends.

tools, abilities, and skins can all be purchased in the shop.

game can be played with up to 12 different people.

game is currently in beta testing; expect lots of bugs


inspired by games like "Slender: The Eight Pages," "Stop It, Slender," and "Slender: The Arrival."
